metadata.title: PILAR-2b - Intelligent Waste Location and Utilization Platform for Biogas and Bioproducts
metadata.description: Open-source geospatial framework for analyzing biogas and bioproduct potential from organic waste in São Paulo state. Interactive mapping, multi-criteria analysis, feedstock-dependent correction factors, and scientific database tools for reproducible research.
metadata.keywords: biogas, bioproducts, renewable energy, São Paulo, geospatial analysis, biomass, MCDA, sustainability, FAPESP, open-source, PILAR-2b, framework, reproducible research

dashboard_hub.welcome_subtitle: Complete platform for biogas potential analysis in São Paulo state
guide_step1_items: Visualize 645 São Paulo municipalities with biogas potential data
Filter by residue type (sugarcane, cattle, swine, MSW, etc.)
Click a municipality to see full details in a horizontal popup
Activate additional layers: MapBiomas, biogas plants, pipelines, transmission lines
guide_step2_items: Click the map to select a point of interest
Set a search radius (e.g. 50 km, 100 km)
View nearby municipalities with aggregated potential
Analyze nearby infrastructure: pipelines, substations, WWTPs, roads
guide_step3_items: Technology Routes: Compare different biogas/biomethane production processes
Scientific Knowledge Base: Access technical residue data — BMP, TS, VS, C/N
Consult parameters validated from international scientific literature
Use to refine calculations and custom analyses
dashboard_hub.guide_tip: Tip: Start by exploring the map to identify regions of interest, then use the analysis tools to deepen your assessment.
dashboard_hub.feat_map_desc: Explore biogas potential in 645 São Paulo municipalities with residue-type filters
dashboard_hub.feat_proximity_desc: Analyse biogas plant feasibility considering nearby infrastructure
dashboard_hub.feat_routes_desc: Compare different biogas and biomethane production technologies
dashboard_hub.feat_scientific_desc: Access technical data on residues, BMP, and anaerobic digestion parameters
dashboard_hub.feat_compare_desc: Compare multiple municipalities side-by-side with biogas potential metrics by sector
dashboard_hub.feat_advanced_desc: Advanced tools for potential analysis and technical feasibility
dashboard_hub.feat_references_desc: Scientific bibliography, data sources and documentation. Each residue has its own analyses and scientific references.
